visualCharacteristics: Horizontal row of compact linked tiles under the hero, each with an icon-font glyph and a label.
contentPattern:
One row per tile: cell 1 the glyph as icon notation (e.g. :product-tv:), cell 2

label

plus an optional

sub text (hidden); the whole tile becomes the link.
usage: Use directly under the hero to give quick links to the most common visitor tasks.
reuseGuidance: Reuse for any row of icon quick-link tiles instead of a generic cards block.
